Einstufung.Title: Pflegegrad

Org.LegalHint: Required in Germany under §5 DDG as soon as the service goes beyond purely private use. These details appear in the imprint and as the controller in the privacy notice. While they are missing, both pages say so openly.

Org.LegalVatIdHint: Enter only if you have one, never invent it.

Org.NotifyDocumentProcessedHint: An email when an uploaded document has been processed.
Org.NotifyIncludeContentHint: Name the patient, document and appointment in subject and body. Off: only a notice with a link. These details then sit with the mail provider and in the recipients' inboxes.
